hypotheses.title: `abi.encodePacked()` Hash Collision
hypotheses.description: abi.encodePacked() should not be used with dynamic types when passing the result to a hash function such as `keccak256()`. Use `abi.encode()` instead which will pad items to 32 bytes, preventing hash collisions: https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/v0.8.13/abi-spec.html#non-standard-packed-mode. (e.g. `abi.encodePacked(0x123,0x456)` => `0x123456` => `abi.encodePacked(0x1,0x23456)`, but `abi.encode(0x123,0x456)` => `0x0...1230...456`). Unless there is a compelling reason, `abi.encode` should be preferred. If there is only one argument to `abi.encodePacked()` it can often be cast to `bytes()` or `bytes32()` instead: https://ethereum.stackexchange.com/questions/30912/how-to-compare-strings-in-solidity#answer-82739. If all arguments are strings and or bytes, `bytes.concat()` should be used instead. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:111, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:230

hypotheses.title: Reentrancy: State change after external call
hypotheses.description: Changing state after an external call can lead to re-entrancy attacks.Use the checks-effects-interactions pattern to avoid this issue. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:95, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:96, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:174

hypotheses.title: Centralization Risk
hypotheses.description: Contracts have owners with privileged rights to perform admin tasks and need to be trusted to not perform malicious updates or drain funds. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:14, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:326, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:14

hypotheses.title: Costly operations inside loop
hypotheses.description: Invoking `SSTORE` operations in loops may waste gas. Use a local variable to hold the loop computation result. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:263, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:309, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:276

hypotheses.title: Large Numeric Literal
hypotheses.description: Large literal values multiples of 10000 can be replaced with scientific notation.Use `e` notation, for example: `1e18`, instead of its full numeric value. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:20, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:251

hypotheses.title: Literal Instead of Constant
hypotheses.description: Define and use `constant` variables instead of using literals. If the same constant literal value is used multiple times, create a constant state variable and reference it throughout the contract. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:95, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:96, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:99

hypotheses.title: Modifier Invoked Only Once
hypotheses.description: Consider removing the modifier or inlining the logic into the calling function. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:123, src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:131, src/campaign/NudgePointsCampaigns.sol:39

hypotheses.title: Loop Contains `require`/`revert`
hypotheses.description: Avoid `require` / `revert` statements in a loop because a single bad item can cause the whole transaction to fail. It's better to forgive on fail and return failed elements post processing of the loop Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:263, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:264, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:276

hypotheses.title: State Variable Could Be Immutable
hypotheses.description: State variables that are only changed in the constructor should be declared immutable to save gas. Add the `immutable` attribute to state variables that are only changed in the constructor Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:37

hypotheses.title: Unchecked Return
hypotheses.description: Function returns a value but it is ignored. Consider checking the return value. Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:102, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:45, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:46

hypotheses.title: Unspecific Solidity Pragma
hypotheses.description: Consider using a specific version of Solidity in your contracts instead of a wide version. For example, instead of `pragma solidity ^0.8.0;`, use `pragma solidity 0.8.0;` Instances: src/campaign/NudgeCampaign.sol:2, src/campaign/NudgeCampaignFactory.sol:2, src/campaign/NudgePointsCampaigns.sol:2
